description: This file is a header (.h) file defining external API function prototypes related to an Audio Codec component in a network service framework. It provides function declarations for creating, removing, enrolling, and initializing audio codec objects, primarily for external use by other modules.

methods.name: AnscCreateAudioCodec
methods.description: Creates an audio codec object with provided container, owner, and reserved handles.

methods.name: AnscAcoCreate
methods.description: Creates an instance of the audio codec, internal to the implementation.

methods.name: AnscAcoRemove
methods.description: Removes the specified audio codec object, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: AnscAcoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls necessary objects into the audio codec instance.

methods.name: AnscAcoInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the audio codec object, preparing it for use.
